description: Blind RDC mutation operator set over the five pinned public designs in tests/public_projects/manifest.json (with reviewed SDCs in tests/public_projects/reviewed_sdc/), revised after independent blind review (fix6). Documented format/corpus gaps: (1) Sequencing and release order (CST-016 via reset_contracts) cannot be expressed because the operator schema targets RTL or SDC only; (2) RDC-002(b) (unconstrained synchronous-only reset input via SDC) has no synchronous-only reset port in the five pinned designs (axis_async_fifo's s_rst/m_rst are also async reset roots and trigger RDC-002(a)).

operators.new: set_input_delay -clock src_clk_i 1.0 [get_ports {src_data_i src_valid_i}]
operators.defect: remove set_input_delay constraint from top-level asynchronous reset input src_rst_ni
operators.precondition: src_rst_ni is a top-level asynchronous reset port driving functional registers in i_src (not only a reset synchronizer); removing its set_input_delay leaves its timing relation to src_clk_i unconstrained.

operators.old:
cc_cdc_fifo_2phase_dst #(
    .data_t     ( data_t     ),
    .LogDepth   ( LogDepth   ),
    .SyncStages ( SyncStages )
  ) i_dst (
    .dst_rst_ni   ( dst_rst_ni  ),
operators.new:
logic dst_rst_unconnected_n;

  cc_cdc_fifo_2phase_dst #(
    .data_t     ( data_t     ),
    .LogDepth   ( LogDepth   ),
    .SyncStages ( SyncStages )
  ) i_dst (
    .dst_rst_ni   ( dst_rst_unconnected_n ),
operators.defect: connect i_dst asynchronous reset to an undriven internal wire dst_rst_unconnected_n
operators.precondition: i_dst contains active asynchronously reset registers in dst_clk_i; replacing top-level port dst_rst_ni with an undriven internal wire leaves the reset root without any modelled driver or release synchronisation.

operators.new:
set_input_delay -clock dst_clk_i 1.0 [get_ports {dst_ready_i}]
set_input_delay -clock src_clk_i 1.0 [get_ports {dst_rst_ni}]
operators.defect: time destination asynchronous reset dst_rst_ni against asynchronous source clock src_clk_i instead of dst_clk_i
operators.precondition: dst_rst_ni directly resets registers clocked by dst_clk_i with no internal reset synchronizer; timing its release against the asynchronous src_clk_i leaves deassertion unsynchronized to dst_clk_i.

operators.defect: clock a 2-stage destination reset synchronizer on negedge dst_clk_i while i_dst receivers use posedge dst_clk_i
operators.precondition: i_dst registers are clocked on posedge dst_clk_i; releasing dst_rst_ni through a 2-stage reset synchronizer clocked on negedge dst_clk_i creates a half-cycle opposite-edge reset release path.

operators.line_anchor: // The receiver in the destination domain.
operators.defect: synchronize dst_rst_ni deassertion through only a single flip-flop stage before resetting i_dst
operators.precondition: 1-stage reset synchroniser; defect under the RDC-006 depth policy, assuming the raw reset is asynchronous as the synchroniser implies

operators.old:
// The receiver in the destination domain.
  cc_cdc_4phase_dst #(
    .data_t(data_t),
    .SyncStages(SyncStages),
    .Decoupled(Decoupled)
  ) i_dst (
    .rst_ni       ( dst_rst_ni  ),
    .clk_i        ( dst_clk_i   ),
    .data_o       ( dst_data_o  ),
    .valid_o      ( dst_valid_o ),
    .ready_i      ( dst_ready_i ),
operators.line_anchor: // The receiver in the destination domain.
operators.defect: tap the intermediate first stage of a 2-stage reset synchronizer to gate functional downstream ready logic
operators.precondition: dst_rst_s1_q -> dst_rst_s2_q forms a recognized 2-stage reset synchronizer for i_dst in dst_clk_i; fanning dst_rst_s1_q out into ready_i exposes active control logic to unresolved recovery metastability.

operators.line_anchor: // The receiver in the destination domain.
operators.defect: drive i_dst asynchronous reset directly from a register clocked in asynchronous domain src_clk_i
operators.precondition: src_clk_i and dst_clk_i are declared asynchronous in cc_cdc_2phase.sdc; generating i_dst's reset from a src_clk_i flop causes asynchronous reset deassertion in dst_clk_i.

operators.defect: combine src_rst_ni and dst_rst_ni with a combinational AND gate to drive i_dst asynchronous reset
operators.precondition: src_rst_ni and dst_rst_ni are distinct top-level asynchronous reset inputs; combining them combinationally onto i_dst's async reset net introduces multi-source reset skew and glitch risk.

operators.old:
// The receiver in the destination domain.
  cc_cdc_4phase_dst #(
    .data_t(data_t),
    .SyncStages(SyncStages),
    .Decoupled(Decoupled)
  ) i_dst (
    .rst_ni       ( dst_rst_ni  ),
operators.line_anchor: // The receiver in the destination domain.
operators.defect: gate asynchronous reset dst_rst_ni with functional data input dst_ready_i
operators.precondition: dst_ready_i is a functional handshake input, not a reset; gating dst_rst_ni with it creates glitch-prone combinational reset logic driving active registers in i_dst.

operators.line_anchor: always @(posedge m_clk or posedge m_rst) begin
operators.defect: mux asynchronous resets s_rst and m_rst with top-level mode/control input m_pause_req before s_rst_sync1_reg
operators.precondition: m_pause_req is a non-reset top-level control input (unused under PAUSE_ENABLE=0); using it to select between s_rst and m_rst introduces a combinational reset mux that can glitch when the select toggles.

operators.new:
) i_spill_register (
      .clk_i,
      .rst_ni(ack_dst_q),
      .clr_i('0),
operators.defect: drive i_spill_register asynchronous reset from functional FSM data register ack_dst_q
operators.precondition: Decoupled defaults to 1 so i_spill_register is instantiated in dst_clk_i; ack_dst_q is a functional handshake register in dst_clk_i, not a reset synchronizer, so using it as an async reset risks pulse-width and glitch defects.

operators.old:
cc_cdc_fifo_2phase_dst #(
    .data_t     ( data_t     ),
    .LogDepth   ( LogDepth   ),
    .SyncStages ( SyncStages )
  ) i_dst (
    .dst_rst_ni   ( dst_rst_ni  ),
operators.defect: gate i_dst asynchronous reset with a register (async_wptr_req / req_src_q) from the source reset domain
operators.precondition: async_wptr_req is driven by i_src.i_cdc_wptr_src.req_src_q which is reset by src_rst_ni, a different reset domain from i_dst; gating dst_rst_ni with it lets a source reset toggle or glitch the destination reset tree.

operators.new: `FFLAR(req_src_q, ~req_src_q, src_accept, 1'b0,       clk_i, rst_ni)
operators.defect: instantiate active-high async reset macro FFLAR on active-low reset port src_rst_ni for req_src_q
operators.precondition: src_rst_ni resets data_src_q and i_sync active-low (negedge); switching req_src_q to FFLAR (posedge) makes src_rst_ni active with both polarities, holding req_src_q in reset during normal operation.

operators.new: `FFNR(req_src_q,  req_src_d,  clk_i)
operators.defect: drop asynchronous reset on req_src_q while its same-clock FSM driver state_q stays asynchronously reset
operators.precondition: i_src.state_q drives req_src_d into i_src.req_src_q on src_clk_i; removing req_src_q's async reset creates a same-clock reset-domain crossing where asserting src_rst_ni changes state_q while req_src_q keeps sampling.

operators.defect: make overflow_sync1_reg asynchronously reset by s_rst while its cross-clock capture overflow_sync2_reg in m_clk is not reset by s_rst
operators.precondition: overflow_sync1_reg (s_clk) -> overflow_sync2_reg (m_clk) is an active cross-clock toggle path under default parameters; converting only the source to async s_rst creates an independent cross-clock reset-domain crossing.

operators.new: `FFNR(req_synced_q1, req_synced, clk_i)
operators.defect: remove asynchronous reset from transition-detector register req_synced_q1 while it feeds reset register ack_dst_q
operators.precondition: req_synced_q1 drives valid_o -> dst_accept -> ack_dst_q in the same module instance cc_cdc_2phase.i_dst; removing its reset lets an unknown/stale post-reset state corrupt ack_dst_q.

operators.new:
always_ff @(posedge src_clk_i or negedge src_rst_ni) begin
    if (!src_rst_ni) begin
      src_wptr_q[LogDepth-1:0] <= '0;
    end else if (fifo_write) begin
      src_wptr_q <= src_wptr_q + 1;
    end
  end
operators.defect: reset only lower index bits [LogDepth-1:0] of packed write pointer src_wptr_q, leaving wrap-around MSB unreset
operators.precondition: src_wptr_q is LogDepth+1 (4) bits wide and its MSB determines FIFO full/empty status on src_ready_o; resetting only LogDepth bits leaves bit 3 unreset after asynchronous reset.

operators.new: `FFL(wptr_q, wptr_d, src_valid_i & src_ready_o, 'x, src_clk_i, src_rst_ni)
operators.defect: assign constant 'x as the asynchronous reset value of write pointer wptr_q feeding primary output src_ready_o
operators.precondition: wptr_q combinationally drives src_ready_o via i_wptr_g2b; forcing 'x on reset leaves wptr_q's reset value undecided and makes top-level output src_ready_o undefined during reset.

operators.defect_class: Asynchronous control conflicts and reset as data
operators.new: .ready_i      ( dst_ready_i & src_rst_ni ),
operators.defect: use asynchronous reset input src_rst_ni as a functional combinational gate on i_dst.ready_i
operators.precondition: src_rst_ni asynchronously resets all registers in i_src; gating i_dst's dst_ready_i with src_rst_ni changes active destination handshake behavior and mixes async-reset and functional-data timing paths on src_rst_ni.

operators.defect_class: Asynchronous control conflicts and reset as data
operators.defect: add an asynchronous active-high set (posedge ready_i) alongside asynchronous active-low clear (negedge rst_ni) on ack_dst_q
operators.precondition: ack_dst_q is an active destination handshake register; adding a second unconditional asynchronous control with opposite forced value creates a simultaneous async set/clear conflict.

operators.new:
set_max_delay -datapath_only 6.5 -from [get_cells *rptr_q*] -to [get_cells *i_src_ptr*]
set_false_path -from [get_ports dst_rst_ni]
operators.defect: apply set_false_path -from [get_ports dst_rst_ni] on asynchronous reset root dst_rst_ni
operators.precondition: dst_rst_ni directly resets functional destination registers in cc_cdc_fifo_gray (not only a reset synchronizer); a false path hides recovery/removal timing checks without establishing reset safety.

operators.new:
set_output_delay -clock dst_clk_i 1.0 [get_ports {dst_data_o dst_valid_o}]
set_multicycle_path 2 -setup -from [get_ports src_rst_ni]
operators.defect: apply set_multicycle_path 2 -setup -from [get_ports src_rst_ni] on asynchronous reset root src_rst_ni
operators.precondition: src_rst_ni directly resets functional source registers in cc_cdc_2phase; relaxing its recovery check with a multicycle exception does not establish reset-domain safety.

operators.new:
set_output_delay -clock dst_clk_i 1.0 [get_ports {dst_data_o dst_valid_o}]
set_false_path -through [get_ports dst_rst_ni]
operators.defect: apply set_false_path -through [get_ports dst_rst_ni] on asynchronous reset root dst_rst_ni
operators.precondition: dst_rst_ni directly resets functional destination registers in cc_cdc_4phase; a -through false path suppresses reset timing checks without establishing reset-domain safety.
